text.en:
The provisions of Section 1 of R.A. 2338, to the contrary notwithstanding, the reward authorized
to be paid qualified informers shall be limited to the sum equivalent to five (5%) per centum of the realized
revenues, surcharges, compromises and penalties established by law, collected and accounted for as a result of
the information furnished.

All laws, acts, decrees, orders, and regulations inconsistent herewith are considered repealed
and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect upon its approval.
DONE in the City of manila, this 27th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
